situation: A worker at a desk crosses off the final row on a wall calendar containing a block of seven daily squares.
subject: a sequence of seven consecutive days
brief: A wall-mounted paper calendar page is shown in crisp pixel art, displaying exactly seven distinct daily squares in a single horizontal row from left to right. A red marker has neatly crossed out all seven boxes, and a glowing digital counter beside the calendar clearly shows the number seven.
